installCommand: cd ../.. && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.4.0 && ~/.bun/bin/bun install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: cd ../.. && PATH=$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH bunx turbo run build --filter=server && cd apps/server && ~/.bun/bin/bun build vercel/entry.ts --target=bun --outfile=api/server.js
